rules.requirement: CosyVoice MUST consume and produce FA3 provider-neutral voice request/result artifacts.
CosyVoice MUST NOT become a voice identity, consent, routing, resource, registry, evidence or session authority.
CosyVoice materialization MUST add zero capabilities and zero architectural authorities; capability count remains 143.
Runtime source MUST be pinned to immutable upstream commit 074ca6dc9e80a2f424f1f74b48bdd7d3fea531cc.
Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 MUST be pinned to immutable model revision 29e01c4e8d000f4bcd70751be16fa94bf3d85a18.
Only model-registry allowlisted model identities may be admitted; arbitrary checkpoint paths are forbidden.
Runtime inference MUST NOT silently fetch model or source bytes from the network.
Current provider runtime MUST use an isolated Python 3.10 venv.
FA3 CosyVoice runtime MUST NOT require Conda/Miniforge.
Current-host admission MUST fail closed when SoX is unavailable.
Language MUST be explicit and checked against the model language policy.
hu/Hungarian MUST be marked experimental and MUST require explicit acknowledgement; it is not production-promotable without dedicated hu-HU quality evidence.
Zero-shot/cross-lingual/instruct voice reference use MUST carry explicit GRANTED VOICE_SYNTHESIS consent.
Reference audio bytes MUST match request reference_audio_sha256 before inference.
Prompt and instruction fields MUST be bounded and treated as scoped provider input, never policy authority.
CUDA execution MUST require a valid Host Resource Broker AcceleratorExecutionLease@1.
GPU execution target MUST be explicit and bound to the HRB lease before provider import/inference.
Promoted output MUST satisfy the canonical 24 kHz mono WAV result contract.
Streaming is an execution projection only and MUST NOT create provider-owned session semantics.
PASS evidence MUST bind request, provider, upstream commit, model revision, reference audio hash, consent provenance, device/lease and output hash.
When the optional provider is disabled, its current-host runtime state MUST NOT block global FA3 promotion.
